facts.text: Tell Spamuel that a hand-written note from a friend made your workday easier
Correct yesterday's detail: the note was from your sister
Ask for quiet company while you finish a drawing
Return and ask whether he remembers who wrote the note
Share how you felt about the conversation and invite him to choose what to talk about.
